title: 跨团队同步与升级
markdown:
# 跨团队同步与升级

## 概述

本章聚焦跨团队同步与问题升级，分为跨团队同步、升级与决策、跨时区沟通、会议效率四个部分。它提供多方协同场景常用的英语词汇，重点是同步进展、推动决策和跨时区协作的表达。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合跨团队会议和书面同步。建议把同步类词汇与升级、决策术语结合学习，提升多方协作中的沟通效率。

## 跨团队同步

| 词汇            | 词性 | 含义       | 常用搭配                                  |
| --------------- | ---- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| cross-team sync | n.   | 跨团队同步 | weekly cross-team sync, sync meeting      |
| dependency      | n.   | 依赖       | cross-team dependency, dependency tracker |
| blocker         | n.   | 阻断问题   | surface blockers, remove blockers         |
| handoff         | n.   | 交接       | team handoff, smooth handoff              |
| interface       | n.   | 接口       | API interface, team interface             |
| contract        | n.   | 契约       | API contract, team contract               |

### 听说例句

> A: In the cross-team sync, the platform team flagged a dependency on our auth service. B: Let's finalize the API contract this week so they're not blocked.

> A: How do we ensure a smooth handoff to the ops team? B: I'll document the interface specs and walk them through the deployment process.

### 写作表达

- Weekly cross-team sync meetings surface dependencies and blockers before they become critical issues.
- A clear API contract between teams reduces integration friction and enables parallel development.

---

## 升级与决策

| 词汇           | 词性 | 含义         | 常用搭配                                    |
| -------------- | ---- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| escalate       | v.   | 升级         | escalate the issue, escalate to leadership  |
| decision-maker | n.   | 决策者       | identify the decision-maker, final decision |
| trade-off      | n.   | 权衡         | present trade-offs, trade-off discussion    |
| unblock        | v.   | 解除阻碍     | unblock the team, unblocking action         |
| SLA            | n.   | 服务等级协议 | escalation SLA, response SLA                |
| owner          | n.   | 负责人       | issue owner, decision owner                 |

### 听说例句

> A: We've been stuck on this for two days. Should we escalate? B: Yes, let's escalate to the director. I'll present the trade-offs so the decision-maker can unblock us.

> A: What's the escalation SLA for P0 issues? B: 30 minutes to acknowledge, 2 hours for the issue owner to provide a status update.

### 写作表达

- Clear escalation paths with defined SLAs ensure that critical issues are addressed within an acceptable timeframe.
- Presenting trade-offs clearly to decision-makers enables faster and more informed unblocking actions.

---

## 跨时区沟通

| 词汇           | 词性 | 含义     | 常用搭配                              |
| -------------- | ---- | -------- | ------------------------------------- |
| time zone      | n.   | 时区     | across time zones, time zone friendly |
| overlap hours  | n.   | 重叠时段 | maximize overlap, limited overlap     |
| async          | adj. | 异步的   | async update, async communication     |
| handover       | n.   | 交接     | shift handover, end-of-day handover   |
| follow-the-sun | n.   | 全球轮转 | follow-the-sun support, 24/7 coverage |
| recording      | n.   | 录像     | share the recording, watch async      |

### 听说例句

> A: We only have 2 hours of overlap with the APAC team. B: Let's use that for sync meetings and handle everything else async with end-of-day handovers.

> A: How do we ensure 24/7 on-call coverage? B: We follow the follow-the-sun model. Each region handles their shift and does a handover to the next.

### 写作表达

- Maximizing overlap hours between distributed teams is essential for synchronous decision-making.
- The follow-the-sun model enables 24/7 operational coverage by distributing on-call responsibilities across time zones.

---

## 会议效率

| 词汇            | 词性 | 含义           | 常用搭配                                        |
| --------------- | ---- | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| action-oriented | adj. | 以行动为导向的 | action-oriented meeting, action-oriented agenda |
| outcome         | n.   | 成果           | meeting outcome, desired outcome                |
| pre-read        | n.   | 会前阅读材料   | share pre-read, review the pre-read             |
| decision        | n.   | 决定           | document decisions, clear decision              |
| accountability  | n.   | 问责           | ensure accountability, accountability framework |
| cadence         | n.   | 节奏           | meeting cadence, regular cadence                |

### 听说例句

> A: This meeting should be action-oriented. What's the desired outcome? B: We need a decision on the migration timeline. I've shared the pre-read for everyone to review beforehand.

> A: Should we change the meeting cadence? B: Yes, bi-weekly instead of weekly. That gives us more time for execution and ensures accountability.

### 写作表达

- Action-oriented meetings with pre-shared materials and clear desired outcomes maximize productivity.
- Adjusting meeting cadence based on project phase ensures the right balance between alignment and execution time.
